lens_perspectives.type_ownership: Resolve whether detailed error reasons or source-provenance guarantees have an owning boundary; no owner is prescribed by the observed text alone.
lens_perspectives.redundant_authority: Original holder identity and cloned resolved identity, and imported versus structurally revalidated geology, have distinct local responsibilities; shared data does not prove duplicate authority is defective.
lens_perspectives.behavior_preservation: Preserve supported absent opposed_to, default directions, label/generated ID fallback, missing geology as None, and distinct coordinate systems in future work.
